profile_text.body:
Course Hero is an online learning platform founded in 2006 and headquartered in Redwood City. The company describes itself as offering instant access to millions of study resources, course notes, test prep materials, 24/7 homework help, and tutors. It operates as a business of Learneo, Inc.

The held facts for this site track QuillBot, a paraphrasing tool categorized under writing and editing, as a product associated with Course Hero's web presence.
